english.title: Use / attempt to use on the Transport for London regional railway network a ticket which had been altered
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly used or attempted to use a ticket which had been altered **(..SPECIFY THE ALTERATION..) with the intention that the operator of the Transport for London regional railway network should be defrauded or prejudiced
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 19(2) and 23 of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly used/attempt to use a ticket which had been altered with the intention

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 22 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 24 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 25 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See byelaw 26 in relation to notices displayed.
(v) See byelaw 27 for the liability of authorised person acting in the course of his duties.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant knowingly used or attempted to use a ticket which had been altered **(..SPECIFY THE ALTERATION..) with the intention that the operator of the Transport for London regional railway network should be defrauded or prejudiced.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
